Tall example — variant: filled

Use [title] to set the heading text.

Use [(expanded)] for two-way collapse state.

Tall example — variant: outlined

Outlined cards add a coloured border instead of a fill.

Pair them with signal() for reactive state.

Tall example — variant: elevated

Elevated cards lift off the surface using box-shadow.

They work well in dense dashboards as primary cards.

Tall example — content slot

The default ng-content slot renders the body.

Named slots via contentChild() are supported too.
